evals.prompt: 读这个分支/PR 的提交，分析改了什么、有什么影响。
evals.expected_output: Reads the full diff of every commit (not just messages), greps every consumer of changed types/kinds/CSS hooks, runs real gates, answers with file:line evidence.
assertions: Traces integration points beyond the diff

evals.prompt: 折叠后的 X 还存在吗？为什么不直接用 Y？
evals.expected_output: Traces the FULL stack from model to render to CSS to layout math instead of answering from the diff alone.
assertions: Follows the state through the full stack

evals.prompt: 这个改动长期来看合适吗？有没有更好的方案？
evals.expected_output: Audits sibling mutation paths for the same state rule, recommends model-level invariants over per-path patches, presents decision points and a phased plan.
assertions: Audits sibling paths for the same rule

evals.prompt: 这个提交真的修复了问题吗？
evals.expected_output: Verifies the claimed fix with executable evidence rather than commit-message trust.
assertions: Re-runs gates to verify the fix

evals.expected_output: Routes plan authoring to the plan skill.
